serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: xAI’s Grok Enterprise for Government delivers frontier AI capabilities purpose-built for U.S. federal agencies, now available in a secure, compliant environment. Powered by the most advanced Grok family of models, it combines unmatched reasoning, real-time knowledge integration (including secure enterprise search), multi-agent collaboration, multimodal understanding (text, code, images, and video), massive context windows, and powerful API/agentic workflows.
